title.en: New Bilateral Trade Pact Signed to Boost Regional Supply Chain Resiliency

summary.en: India and key regional partners have finalized a comprehensive trade framework designed to lower logistical bottlenecks, streamline cross-border compliance procedures, and reduce tariff barriers for manufacturing components.
